name: gdocumentor
description: Socratic AI writing & code review coach and 0-token Google Docs editor (Go CLI, Zero-GEMINI_API_KEY Host-AI MCP Server & 7-Client Skill Installer with WSL2<->Windows bridge). Proofreads local files, scoped GitHub/code ranges (--auto-deps), Web URLs, or Google Docs with bottom-up UTF-16 inline suggestions (WriteMode.SUGGEST), Socratic hints (--hint), multimodal figure/table checks, RAG rulebooks, AI+Human review learning summaries, and direct Markdown/table/image editing.
suggestedPrompts: Proofread a specific function or line range in a local script or GitHub repo into Google Docs (--auto-deps)
Review an existing Google Document in Socratic Hint-Only mode (-m hint) and show the Writing Coach & Learning Summary
Directly edit a Google Document: insert converted rich Markdown (headings, tables, lists, images) or insert/replace/delete images at any position
